title: Modern Regen
description: Modern Regen backports Minecraft's modern natural regeneration system to Forge 1.7.10, replacing the legacy hunger regeneration with the faster, saturation-based mechanics introduced in newer versions.
body:
# Modern Regen

Modern Regen brings Minecraft's modern natural regeneration mechanics to Forge 1.7.10.

Instead of the slower legacy hunger regeneration system, players heal using saturation first when their hunger bar is full, closely matching the behavior found in newer Minecraft versions. Once saturation is depleted, regeneration falls back to slower hunger-based healing, while starvation and other vanilla hunger mechanics continue to function normally.

The mod is lightweight, standalone, and designed to stay true to vanilla gameplay while modernizing one of Minecraft's core survival mechanics.

## Features

* Backports modern saturation-based natural regeneration to Minecraft 1.7.10
* Fast healing while saturation is available
* Slower hunger-based regeneration after saturation is depleted
* Preserves vanilla starvation mechanics
* Respects the `naturalRegeneration` gamerule
* Lightweight implementation with dedicated server support
* Configurable regeneration timing and exhaustion values
